summary: Nektar Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to disclose 52-week topline results from the blinded 16-week treatment extension period of its Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA study of rezpegaldesleukin in alopecia areata. The filing provides a press release and presentation with clinical data. There are no transaction terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics related to a special situation. The filing is a routine disclosure of clinical trial results, not a corporate event meeting the defined special-situation categories.
